messages:
elaine: Quick design check — noticed the y-axis unit abbreviations are inconsistent across dashboards (e.g., 'ms', 'milliseconds', 'msec') and the default trendline smoothing is masking short spikes that matter for error budgets. Proposal: standardize to compact units (ms, s, %) in-axis and put full unit + description in hover. Also add an optional 'show outliers' toggle per chart.

mike: +1 on standardizing units. UX question: do we always show abbreviated units on axis or only when there's space? Some small sparklines will break.

rachel: prefer always show short unit on axis (e.g., "ms") and have the full label in tooltip. For tiny charts, use the legend area to include unit.

samir: technical: if we enable per-chart outlier toggle, it needs to be cheap. We can implement outlier suppression client-side by clipping values by percentile and rendering a tiny outlier marker when toggled.

aria: a couple accessibility nits: 1) abbreviations must expand via aria-label, e.g., `aria-label="milliseconds (ms)"`. 2) smoothing reduces perceivable changes; if smoothing is on by default, provide an easy keyboard toggle and make the unsmoothed data available to screen readers.

samir: rough config sketch:
```
chart: {
  yUnit: "ms",
  smoothing: true,
  smoothingWindow: 3,
  outlierHandling: "clip", // options: clip, show, highlight
  showOutliers: false
}
```

elaine: @aria yep, include aria-expanded and a11y copy. Also copy tweak: change tooltip header from "Latency" to "Request latency (p50/p95)" so it's explicit.

rachel: what about legend density? If we move units into legend for small charts, we need to ensure legend text doesn't get truncated. Maybe allow wrapping or tooltip on hover.

mike: concern: clipping by percentile could hide real production incidents. Make default conservative (clip at 99.9th) and wire eval alerts to raw-data pipeline.

aria: small follow-up: include a focus order that goes Chart -> Toggle smoothing -> Toggle outliers -> Legend. That keeps keyboard users oriented.

elaine: action items:
- standardize unit abbrev mapping (ms, s, %, req/s)
- add aria-label expansions
- implement per-chart outlier toggle (default off, clip at 99.9%)
- add keyboard toggles for smoothing/outliers and surface unsmoothed raw values
- update tooltip copy to explicit metric names

mike: can frontend own the unit mapping? i'll file a PR with mapping + storybook examples.

rachel: i'll update the design spec and include compact + small-sparkline variants.

samir: i'll prot a clip/highlight toggle and measure perf.

a11y-bot: reminder — run axe checks on updated components and tag the PR with `a11y-review`.

elaine: thanks everyone — syncing Thurs 10am to review prototypes. :calendar:
